appearance.extreme: They are wearing hide instead of skin. It creases rather than folds, and the rain beads and runs off them like off a tarpaulin.
appearance.obvious: Their skin is thick and leathery, creased into plates at the elbows and across the back of the neck.
appearance.subtle: Their forearms have a dull, hide-like sheen where the skin has thickened.

description: Your skin has gone thick and leathery, hide more than skin. Rain stops mattering. So does most of what you touch.
drawbacks: Everything feels like it is through a glove
name: Dermal Thickening
